title: GTA 6 Leaks: Rockstar Struggles With More Gameplay Footage
description: Eurogamer reports that Rockstar Games is struggling to contain new GTA 6 gameplay footage as a leaker shares material suggesting access to a playable build.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Development in the Spotlight Amid New Footage Leaks

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, *Grand Theft Auto VI* has once again found itself at the center of a security discussion. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, the developer is struggling to contain an influx of new gameplay videos as a leaker shares footage that suggests a link or access to a playable build of the game.

### Navigating Unverified Claims

Keeping high-profile projects under wraps is notoriously difficult in the modern gaming landscape. The latest wave of rumors and circulating clips highlights the ongoing challenges faced by studios working on heavily anticipated titles.

However, caution is warranted when evaluating these online claims. As noted in updates from Eurogamer, earlier assertions suggesting that the leaker possessed "full access" to the game were found to be based on declarations from what appeared to be an impersonating social media account, correcting previous assumptions.

### Editor's Take

While the constant stream of leaks can be exciting or frustrating for the community, it is essential to separate speculation from confirmed facts. Until Rockstar Games chooses to share official updates, players should approach these unverified leaks with a grain of salt and wait for official announcements from the studio. (Unconfirmed rumor)
